label: ex:dagger-su2
title: Involutive structure on $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}(2))$
html: The representation category \mathbf{C} = \mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}(2)) carries a canonical dagger structure compatible with the Hopf \ast-structure of its coordinate algebra. For any equivariant map f \colon V_j \to V_k, its dagger f^{\dagger} is the standard Hilbert-space adjoint, satisfying \langle f^{\dagger}(w), v \rangle_j = \langle w, f(v) \rangle_k; this adjoint remains equivariant because the inner product on each irreducible representation V_j is \mathrm{SU}(2)-invariant. On the coordinate algebra A = \mathcal{O}(\mathrm{SU}(2)), the positive GNS pairing \langle f, h \rangle_{L^2} = \int_{\mathrm{SU}(2)} f^*(g)h(g)\,d\mu_{\mathrm{Haar}}(g) uses the conjugate-linear pointwise \ast-involution f^*(g) = \overline{f(g)} (which extends to non-involutive Hopf \ast-deformations via (S \circ *)^2 = \mathrm{id}_A, whereas \overline{f(g^{-1})} = (S \circ *)(f)(g) is the convolution involution). Unitarity manifests categorically as the positivity of the composite f^{\dagger} \circ f = \lVert f(1) \rVert^2 > 0 for any non-zero state f \colon \mathbb{C} \to V_j.
